name: jtbd-research-skills
description: JTBD agent skills for product discovery

plugins.name: jtbd-skills
plugins.description:
Understand your customers deeply. Turn customer interviews or online feedback into an opportunity map of ranked jobs to be done, with the quotes behind each job and clearly labelled AI-estimated scores you can review and edit.

Run /jtbd with your research files, or a product or service website—for example:

/jtbd https://www.airbnb.com/
